bridge_api_route_t

Route record stored by bridge_api_set_route().

Fields
direction

Requested traffic direction. HPS-to-FPGA bridges reject FPGA-to-HPS-only routing, and the FPGA-to-HPS bridge rejects HPS-to-FPGA-only routing.

base_addr

Base address retained in software with the route record. The current middleware does not program it into hardware.

window_size

Window size retained in software with the route record. The current middleware does not program it into hardware.

Types
bridge_api_flow_ctrl_t

Flow-control value stored by bridge_api_set_flow_ctrl(). Not programmed into a flow-control register.

Values
BRIDGE_API_FLOW_NONE

No flow control.

BRIDGE_API_FLOW_BACKPRESSURE

Ready/valid backpressure.

BRIDGE_API_FLOW_CREDIT

Credit-based flow control.
